steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Boolean algebra uses variables with values 0 or 1; operations are AND (·), OR (+) and NOT (overbar). | Key Fact: Identity laws: A + 0 = A, A · 1 = A; null element laws: A + 1 = 1, A · 0 = 0. | Key Fact: Idempotent laws: A + A = A, A · A = A; complement laws: A + Ā = 1, A · Ā = 0. | Key Fact: Commutative: A + B = B + A, A · B = B · A; Associative: (A + B) + C = A + (B + C).
